name: All Seasons - Chinesisches Erlebnisrestaurant

name: Asia Deli

name: Bambus China Restaurant
researchNotes: Only directory listings and generic reviews; no website, menu or press naming a region.

name: Ben Wei

name: Chi-Chi-Kan

name: China City
researchNotes: Broad menu described as "predominantly from the Asian region" plus dim sum. The restaurant's own site serves a self-signed TLS certificate and could not be read directly.

name: China Food

name: China Garden

name: China Haus

name: China Restaurant Evergreen

name: China Restaurant Panda II

name: China Snack

name: China Town Restaurant

name: China-Restaurant Hua Ting

name: China-Restaurant Hui Feng

name: China-Restaurant Neu Wuzhou

name: Chuwoo

name: Deli-House

name: Dump Ling

name: En Lee Cai - China Restaurant

name: Feast

name: Feng Yuan

name: Fu Duo

name: Goji

name: Golden Garden

name: Green Flavor

name: Happy Buddha

name: Hot Spot

name: Hua Li Du

name: Jade Palast 2

name: Jing Yang

name: Kaiser Drachen
researchNotes: Only German business directories and local-paper listings, all describing generic "chinesische Spezialitäten". Address resolved to Stubenrauchstraße 78, 12487.

name: Kamala-Vegan
reason: Multiple co-equal regions; no single dominant tradition

name: Kongfu Chili
researchNotes: The restaurant's own site deliberately avoids a regional claim, saying only "authentische chinesische kulinarische Erfahrung". Berlin Food Stories calls it Sichuan, but the signature item is a Shaanxi belt noodle — the two signals point at different regions.

name: Ky Ngo Asia-Imbiss

name: Lao Xiang

name: Le Moon China Restaurant
researchNotes: Now trades as "Willing China Restaurant"; the OpenStreetMap name is stale. Descriptions mention Sichuan heat alongside standard sweet-and-sour dishes, with no dominant tradition.

name: Lecker Song
researchNotes: The menu is organised purely by dumpling type with no regional framing; "dim sum" here means assorted dumplings rather than a Cantonese yum cha service.

name: Lei's Küche

name: Lon-Men
researchNotes: A long-running third-generation delivery restaurant offering Szechuan dishes, Peking duck and vegetarian options together — a broad German-Chinese menu. Not the same business as Lon Men's Noodle House, a separate Taiwanese restaurant on Kantstraße.

name: Long Li House
reason: Multiple co-equal regions; no single dominant tradition

name: Long March Canteen
reason: Multiple co-equal regions; no single dominant tradition

name: Look & Feel Restaurant 008GRILL

name: Lu Kitchen

name: Lucky chinese

name: Man-Far

name: Mayflower

name: Ming Dynastie

name: Panda Garden

name: Phoenix China Restaurant

name: Zhong Hua

name: Zhou's Fine
